design.runtime_default: serial when BEGLIN_QV2_NATIVE_ASYNC=0; staged env only valid when =1
design.stages: Q/K/V and Gate/Up only; preserve attention/O/SwiGLU/Down/residual dependencies and barriers
design.safe_threads: Each asynchronous role owns its own Q4 1t or Q4 6t pool, no shared q4pool concurrent calls
design.comparisons: same original BF16 model, original quantized 28 n8 168 q4 tensor mask, same 8 public evaluation prompts fixed before mode selection
design.initial_measurement: one native single-token warm bench per mode, reverse-order repeat for guard against cache/time drift; no mode accepted as beneficial without repeated >5% gain
design.accuracy: first 151936 logits exact equality and 131 public teacher-forced token NLL/PPL for chosen/worst stage modes; no full-label task accuracy
design.selection: exploratory engineering only, not independent scientific quality selection. If no repeated robust >=1.05 speed ratio, recommend serial/off
design.disallowed: do not change main, production runtime, release, checkpoint, original V6 final, previously blocked per-tensor output interventions

limits: Whole-model first-token only and few repetitions; cannot prove sustained throughput
This evaluates scheduling, not new source-activation precision policy
Inspect actual enabled QKV/FFN join counts per mode, reject false async claims
Original reference source-BF16 widened F32 is not native BF16 math
No downstream causal quality, IID/OOD, GPU Metal, live promotion
